run_multinode_training: run distributed EgoCLIP training across multiple nodes using SLURM or PyTorch launcher
run_single_node_training: run single-node distributed training on all available GPUs with NCCL backend
handle_slurm_preemption: handle SLURM job preemption by requeuing the job on SIGUSR1 signal
init_dataloaders: initialize train and validation data loaders from config supporting single or multiple loaders
setup_optimizer_schedule: setup optimizer and learning rate scheduler with warmup steps based on config
